Hi Alan / Rachel —

Thanks again for the strong interest in Redwood. We have the product briefing scheduled with your team next week and want to confirm CTO-level presence (requested by your exec sponsor) plus a clear fallback if the CTO is pulled into another commitment.

Proposed slots (all PT):
 - Tue Apr 18, 10:00–10:30
 - Wed Apr 19, 14:00–14:30

If Alan can attend that would be ideal — if not, we want to lock an internal backup from our end who can handle the exec-level Q&A and handoff. Attached is the draft agenda (brief, exec-focused).

Agenda highlights: 10-min business context, 10-min demo (latency/cost SLOs), 10-min integration & next steps.

Please let me know your preference and whether your CTO prefers 30 or 45 minutes. We will provision an exec backup (Marcus/Stephanie) and send a calendar invite once we confirm.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
